page_title: MON 4-2 AUX | Monaco v Auxerre 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Auxerre.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 6:6.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Gideon Mensah and he is replaced by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).
87' That's the end of the game for Takumi Minamino, who is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
83' A player from Auxerre commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
82' What was Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
81' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
79' Monaco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
78' Ball possession – 61:39.
76' Substitution. Assane Diousse (Auxerre) replaces Lassine Sinayoko.
76' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Clement Akpa will be replaced by Florian Aye (Auxerre).
76' Substitution. Han-Noah Massengo did his best and is replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
75' A substitution has been made. Paul Joly goes off and Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) comes on.
75' The Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Abdelatif Kherradji rules it out for a foul.
71' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) is cautioned by the referee.
69' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) makes a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Monaco, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
68' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
65' 4 - 2 Goal! Mika Biereth (Monaco) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:2.

63' 3 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Mika Biereth (Monaco) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
62' Here is a change. Vanderson is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
61' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
57' 2 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Mika Biereth (Monaco) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
55' Mika Biereth (Monaco) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
55' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.
54' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Abdelatif Kherradji no option but to blow his whistle.
52' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Auxerre.
51' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Monaco enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Lamine Camara (Monaco) comes off for Soungoutou Magassa.
46' Adi Hutter makes a half-time substitution. Breel Embolo (Monaco) comes on in place of Aleksandr Golovin.
46' The game is over for Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco). Caio Henrique comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jubal Junior (Auxerre) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Radoslaw Majecki no chance!
45+6' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+6' Wait! The referee has seen an infringement and Jubal Junior (Auxerre) will have to take the penalty again!

45+6' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Radoslaw Majecki anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
45+5' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+4' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Auxerre.
45+4' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+3' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner.
45+2' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) steps up to send the ball in.

45+2' Radoslaw Majecki pulls off a great save to deny Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. Auxerre earn a corner.
45+2' Neat passing move from Auxerre in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Auxerre control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
42' The percentage of ball possession is – 65:35.

38' 1 - 1 Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the top right corner.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
35' The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

33' A short pass finds Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
33' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
30' Paul Joly (Auxerre) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
28' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

26' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Radoslaw Majecki. This effort really didn't trouble him.
25' Auxerre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

20' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Donovan Leon. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monaco.
16' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Auxerre players look gutted.
15' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) has a goal ruled out for offside!
14' The Monaco players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
9' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
7' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
5' Great teamplay by Monaco as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Auxerre will have the kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will officiate today.
